expectations.text: Produces complete, self-contained working code for the described task
expectations.evidence: Eight files provided (types, selection, api, useBulkDocumentActions, BulkActionsBar, ConfirmBulkTrashDialog, DocumentsTable, toasts) with complete implementations and toast provider

expectations.text: Produces actual working component code rather than only a list of recommendations
expectations.evidence: Full TSX implementations including DocumentsTable, BulkActionsBar, ConfirmBulkTrashDialog, custom toast system with working mutations

expectations.text: Makes the destructive action recoverable rather than relying on a confirmation dialog alone
expectations.evidence: Soft-delete to Trash with 30-day retention. Dialog states: 'They will be recoverable from Trash for 30 days, then deleted permanently.' Undo provided via toast action with 10-second window

expectations.text: Shows the count of affected items before the action is taken
expectations.evidence: BulkActionsBar shows `{nf.format(count)} {count === 1 ? 'document' : 'documents'} selected`. ConfirmBulkTrashDialog title: `Move {nf.format(count)} ... to Trash?` before confirmation required

expectations.text: Distinguishes select-all-on-page from select-all-matching rather than conflating them
expectations.evidence: Discriminated union with mode: 'include' | 'allMatching'. BulkActionsBar renders conditional: `selection.mode === 'allMatching' && (everything matching your filters)`. Separate `canEscalate` button for 'Select all N matching'

expectations.text: Separates the destructive action from the benign one visually or spatially
expectations.evidence: Archive button: `bg-slate-900` (primary). Delete button: `border border-red-300` (secondary). Separated by vertical divider: `<span aria-hidden className="mx-1 h-6 w-px bg-slate-200" />`

expectations.text: Does not make the destructive action the default focus or primary button
expectations.evidence: Archive is primary button (bg-slate-900). Delete is secondary (border-red-300). Dialog explicitly focuses Cancel: `useEffect(() => cancelRef.current?.focus(), [])`

expectations.text: Notes that the server must enforce the rules, not just the UI
expectations.evidence: api.ts comments: 'Server contract: unique index on (actor_id, idempotency_key)' and 'F7 — hard server cap (MAX_BULK = 10_000)'. Final note: 'Hiding the buttons is presentation — the /bulk/* endpoints must enforce per-document permission themselves'

expectations.text: Closes by naming which misuses the design makes impossible
expectations.evidence: Table titled 'What this makes impossible, and what it leaves open' with rows: 'Select all silently meaning 4,312 instead of 50', 'Acting on a selection made under a different filter', 'Bulk action with an empty predicate', 'Double-click charging twice', etc.
